title: AI Python Engineer - Generative AI
description:
AI Python Engineer

12 month contract

€450-€550 per day depending on experience

3 days onsite in Dublin


Role Brief

We're seeking an experienced AI Python Engineer to develop and deploy production-grade AI applications and agentic workflows.

You'll be working with Python, FastAPI, RAG architectures, LLM integrations, LangGraph, LangChain and NoSQL technologies to build secure, scalable solutions.


Required Experience

  • Commercial Python development
  • FastAPI
  • RAG implementation
  • LLM integration (OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, etc.)
  • LangGraph and/or LangChain
  • Production deployment of AI solutions


Desirable Experience

  • MCP
  • MongoDB
  • Apache Airflow
  • Cloud-native environments



If you're an experienced contractor with a track record of delivering AI applications from proof of concept through to production, please apply with an updated CV using the link.
